method: Each process has five warm repeats after its first invocation, with GPU isolation checked. Enabled wall times separate reconstruction, field-to-mesh and full mesh-loss backward. Forward-only A-B-B-A uses unchanged PR83 baseline A and candidate B. Separate event profiles include host submission gaps.
scope: Upload, bounds/seed preparation and validation are excluded. Full backward includes mesh, field and reconstruction to inputs. Pool peak includes retained arrays/checkpoints and excludes native CUDA graph storage.
